yields.label: Food
yields.description: Workers in agriculture, forestry, fishing & hunting, counted where they live (ACS C24030).

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Workers in manufacturing, construction and mining, counted where they live (ACS C24030).

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross domestic product per year in current dollars, counted where the work is done (BEA CAGDP2, all industries). Metro GDP is the sum of the metro's counties (OMB 2023 delineations); for Virginia's combined county + independent city areas BEA reports one figure, split here by population only where the parts fall in different metros.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: Workers in professional, scientific & technical services and the information sector, counted where they live (ACS C24030).

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: Workers in arts, entertainment & recreation, counted where they live (ACS C24030).

gdp_industries.government: Government & government enterprises (federal, state & local, incl. public schools & hospitals)

energy.note: Only the power plants and wind/solar/battery clusters mapped as resources, each above its type's size threshold (e.g. gas plants of 1,500 MW or more), are counted: this is not the state's total generating capacity.
